etsy.title: ADHD Sticker Sheet, 6 Funny Neurodivergent Kiss-Cut Stickers, Spoon Theory, Hyperfocus, ADHD Gift for Her
etsy.description:
A sticker sheet of six funny ADHD stickers for the neurodivergent brain: the ADHD tax receipt, hyperfocus loading, keys moved to another dimension, out of spoons, I have a thing at 4:00, and 42 tabs open.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One kiss-cut sticker sheet, 5.83 × 8.27 in (A5), shipped directly to you
• 6 stickers, each about 2.4 in: ADHD Tax receipt, Hyperfocus Loading, Keys Missing, Out of Spoons, Thing at 4:00, 42 Tabs Open
• Each sticker is cut individually, so you can peel them off one at a time
• For indoor use. Not waterproof

HOW TO USE
• Laptops, water bottles kept out of the dishwasher, planners, journals, notebooks and phone cases
• A ready-made gift for an ADHD friend, a spoonie, a coworker or yourself, or a stocking stuffer that costs less than six separate stickers

Printed on demand and shipped from the nearest Printify print partner.
